import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtCore import QPoint, QRect, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QAction, QIcon, QIconEngine, QKeySequence, QPainter, QPixmap, QRegion
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget
python.setup:
class GlyphEngine(QIconEngine):
    def __init__(self, glyph):
        super().__init__()
        self._glyph = glyph
    def clone(self):
        return GlyphEngine(self._glyph)
    def pixmap(self, size, mode, state):
        pm = QPixmap(size)
        pm.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)
        renderer = fluentqt.FontIcon(self._glyph)
        renderer.setIconSize(min(size.width(), size.height()))
        renderer.setEnabled(mode != QIcon.Mode.Disabled)
        renderer.resize(size)
        painter = QPainter(pm)
        renderer.render(painter, QPoint(), QRegion(), QWidget.RenderFlag.DrawChildren)
        painter.end()
        return pm
    def paint(self, painter, rect, mode, state):
        dpr = max(1, round(painter.device().devicePixelRatioF())) if painter.device() else 1
        painter.drawPixmap(rect, self.pixmap(rect.size() * dpr, mode, state))

control = fluentqt.CommandPalette(%PARENT%)
control.setAnimationEnabled(False)
for text, glyph, group, keys, shortcut in (
    ("New file", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Add, "File", ["create"], QKeySequence.StandardKey.New),
    ("Open recent...", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Folder, "File", ["browse"], QKeySequence.StandardKey.Open),
    ("Save workspace", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Save, "File", ["write"], QKeySequence.StandardKey.Save),
    ("Open settings", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Settings, "App", ["prefs"], QKeySequence.StandardKey.Preferences),
):
    action = QAction(text, control)
    action.setIcon(QIcon(GlyphEngine(glyph)))
    action.setShortcut(shortcut)
    control.addCommand(action, group, keys)
control.open()
